debrief db-021
1) the actor d-e-f-e-a-t-e-d the f-a-c-i-a-l a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l by r-e-p-l-a-c-i-n-g the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e and left a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t log while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the actor e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d a f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e using a f-o-r-g-e-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d and left a c-l-o-n-e-d u-s-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e in the d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y s-e-r-v-i-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
3) the actor e-n-t-e-r-e-d r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d a-r-e-a-s under the i-m-p-e-r-s-o-n-a-t-e d a-t-a-b-a-s-e account and left a m-i-s-d-a-t-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s-t-o-k-e-n i-n t-h-e g-a-t-e-w-a-y l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n a-l-i-a-s-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-y
4) the actor m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g s-t-r-e-a-m to r-e-l-a-b-e-l e-n-t-r-i-e-s as an a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e and left a f-r-a-g-m-e-n-t-e-d a-u-d-i-t-t-r-a-i-l w-i-t-h g-a-p-s in the t-i-m-e-l-i-n-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s-u-m
5) the actor c-l-e-a-n-e-d u-p t-e-m-p-o-r-a-r-y f-i-l-e-s and left a r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l s-c-r-i-p-t in the c-a-c-h-e folder while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w
